extracted.name: Sugar-Free Graham Cracker Crust
extracted.description: If you're thinking light desserts, then this crust is a must. There's no sugar in this recipe, just graham crackers and butter. This is the perfect quick-fix crust if you need to make a slew of pies. It stirs up and bakes in minutes.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
In a medium bowl, mix together graham cracker crumbs and melted butter. Place mixture in a 9-inch pie pan and press firmly into the bottom and sides of the pan.
Bake in the preheated oven for 8 minutes.
